body:
Stellar Lifespan Engineering Research. Investigates theoretical methods of influencing stellar evolution or extracting useful energy over astronomical timescales.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 92 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Beyond the Apex: Extreme Speculative Technologies". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: inconsistent with current physics. EXTREME THOUGHT EXPERIMENT. No known physical process lets engineers influence stellar evolution; the energy scales are beyond any conceivable technology.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Stellar Lifespan Engineering Research - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Investigates theoretical methods of influencing stellar evolution or extracting useful energy over astronomical timescales.
body:
Known science foundations of Stellar Lifespan Engineering Research.

Stellar evolution theory (nuclear burning stages) is well validated. Star-lifting concepts (Criswell) are theoretical. Shkadov thrusters are analyzed but unbuilt. There is no experimental program that alters a star; the field is pure theory with no pathway to practice.

Key quantity check (Solar luminosity in W / total human power in W): computed ratio 21266700000000 against the reference value, relative error 0.001565, within the stated tolerance of 0.2. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Stellar Lifespan Engineering Research - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Investigates theoretical methods of influencing stellar evolution or extracting useful energy over astronomical timescales.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Stellar Lifespan Engineering Research.

Stellar energy scales dwarf any engineering. No mechanism couples technology to stellar cores. Timescales are millions to billions of years.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 13.58 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is stellar power vs engineering power at 13.58 orders of magnitude (stellar power larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
